text_block_list.name: Pocket's Underling
text_block_list.text:
――It's been so long since the last one! 
You can't help but get fired up, right, 
Pokke-san?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm, well... yeah.
choice_data_list: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah... there was this racing game me and my 
friends used to be super into. Apparently 
they're holding another tournament for it, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Underling
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san was a legend there too, y'know! 
After all, she was the undisputed champ!
choice_data_list: What kind of racing game is it?
What kind of racing game is it?

text_block_list.text:
In the video of a past tournament shown to 
me on the smartphone, footage of a game 
was playing.

"...Yet, every car that rolled out either 
had an insanely massive bumper or a 
tailpipe stretched out freakishly long 
like a snake—"
choice_data_list: (…So it's a game all about cars, huh)

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Underling
text_block_list.text:
And... at the next tournament, as the 
champion, Pokke-san, I want you to accept 
the winner's challenge!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well... fine. If you wanna go, I'll take 
you on.
choice_data_list:
...You don't seem very hyped, considering 
this is a competition.

...You don't seem very hyped, considering 
this is a competition.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...No, you know. Back when I was champ, 
how should I put it... Things had gotten 
completely routine and dull."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The ones who make it through are always 
the usual faces. ...And then, I win. 
Before I knew it, I just grew sick and 
tired of that same old repetition.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...It was fun until I pulled a cut above 
the rest. Back when I was still fighting 
on equal ground with everyone, that is."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, well... my youth is long over. At 
least as far as that game goes.

...Even though it was supposed to be a 
race. I just couldn't forget the cold look 
in Jungle Pocket's eyes.
choice_data_list: (This is where... I'll handle it!)
(This is where... I'll handle it!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh? That person walking over there... 
is Trainer, right?)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...What the heck is she doing...? Wearing 
gigantic sunglasses and a massive 
pompadour wig... Does she actually think 
that's a disguise?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...The direction she's heading towards... 
Is our old hangout spot—

...I see. If there's no one around to fire 
her up... then all I have to do is train 
hard and become "the one who fires her up" 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Rough Regular
text_block_list.text:
...Who the hell are you? Ain't seen your 
mug before, what're you here for?
choice_data_list:
I heard there's a particularly intense 
racing game here.

text_block_list.name: Rough Regular
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. I see. Fine by me. Take a seat at 
that cabinet over there.
choice_data_list:
(Anyway... time for some serious 
training!)

text_block_list.name: Arcade Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
You dumbass! This isn't a place for 
pathetic weaklings to come and go as they 
please! Get the hell outta here and don't 
come back!!
choice_data_list: ……It's nothing. Still a long way to go……

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...That's the fifth store already, huh. 
She just keeps losing, but she never gives 
up... ...And besides.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...You've got that fiery look in your 
eyes, haven't ya?
And then—the day of the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Tournament Play-by-Play
text_block_list.text:
And now! Advancing to the finals is the 
former head of the Big Four, "Yoroshiku in 
Kanji"! Facing them is a mysterious 
newcomer! Their name is—
choice_data_list: My name is—"Big T."
My name is—'Big T'

text_block_list.name: Tournament Play-by-Play
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho! Her name is already on the roster, 
so there was no need to introduce herself, 
yet she went out of her way to do so! Just 
who is she!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "...Haha! I knew you'd climb back up!"

text_block_list.name: Kanji de 4649
text_block_list.text:
Ora ora! Take this!! Thousand Billion 
Hundred Crash!

text_block_list.name: Stirred Gallery
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, that's the killer move that sends 
the opponent's car into a wild spin! 
Haven't seen that in ages!" "Welp, that 
settles the match..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that's her winning formula. She 
used to challenge me with that in the 
past, too. But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Your soul ain't so lukewarm that it can be 
kept down by such worn-out tricks, is it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Show 'em... What going truly full-throttle 
looks like!!
choice_data_list:
(Now's the time...to show the results of 
my training!!)

text_block_list.name: Tournament Play-by-Play
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!?!? She used the momentum from the 
spin to rotate at high speed!! Catching 
the opponent's car on her bumper... and 
launching them right off the track!

text_block_list.name: Kanji de 4649
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat?! M-My car?!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Play-by-Play
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe my eyes! Defeating the 
powerhouse champions of the old era, the 
winner is... the unknown newcomer, "Big 
T"!!
choice_data_list: ...It's finally here... my "partner."
...It's finally here... my "partner."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Welcome... to the peak.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――You oughta know damn well! Once the race 
is done, there's only gonna be one of us 
left standing!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, I'd forgotten for so long... that 
this game could make me feel this way!"
choice_data_list: Looks like you're fired up, Champ!
Looks like you're all fired up, Champ!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, did my engine roar give me away? 
Alright then, let's go!!"

"Words were no longer needed. What was 
etched into history that day... was a 
brand-new legend in the making."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously. Even with all the hours we've 
dumped into this, I'm impressed you found 
a trick we didn't know.
choice_data_list:
It's all for the sake of a thrilling 
contest. With you—

It is all for the sake of a fierce clash. 
With you—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heh... Honestly, you never change!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's roll!! Start the 
engine!!

At the "pinnacle" she finally reached, she 
fought a fierce race against Jungle Pocket 
as a fellow challenger.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I thought my engine had gone completely 
cold. Turns out... you've gone and lit a 
fire in it again.
choice_data_list: That's why I came all this way.
That's why I came all this way.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, partner.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well then... let's race hard enough to 
light a fire under our asses!!

The greatest showdown, as the greatest 
partners. True to their resolve, they 
engaged in a dead heat so intense it could 
melt solid iron.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll give ya my thanks. I thought I didn't 
care 'bout the champ title or whatever... 
but suddenly, I don't feel like giving it 
up.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Because someone went and awakened my 
street-racer spirit!
choice_data_list:
Glad to hear it... Let's make this a 
thrilling race!

Glad to hear it... Let's make this a 
thrilling match!

text_block_list.text:
And so... they engaged in an intensely 
heated showdown with their buddy, Jungle 
Pocket.
